facts.text: Dad says I'm grounded, but the chips and dip are at Play's party.
facts.why: Kid does not say this in the film. His real situation is that Pop grounds him after a school letter about the fight with Stab, and he sneaks out anyway.
facts.fix: Pop says I'm grounded, but I'm going to Play's party anyway.

fix_note.text: Pop says I'm grounded, but I'm going to Play's party anyway.

facts.text: Pop dozed off to Dolemite. Kid snuck out.
facts.why: Wikipedia says Pop wakes when the door closes behind Kid. Dolemite is not mentioned in the sources I opened.
facts.fix: Pop was asleep. Kid snuck out.

vibe.verdict: A neat photo booth layout in the right era, but the food is party standards and the film's wild moments are missing.
missing: Kid and Play's kick step dance-off at the house
Kid rapping in the jail cell to avoid trouble
Stab and his brothers trying to burn the house down
Sydney sneaking Kid out and tricking Pop
Pop waiting with a belt at the end
ideas: Swap 'Strawberry milkshake' note for the jail cell rap, 'Cell block shake'.
Rename 'Party sheet cake' to 'Stab's burnt house cake' with charred edges.
Replace 'Kick step party sub' with the pair of dance shoes made of garlic bread.
